Publish.LongDescription:
# Beta Test Driving Mod
Beta Test Driving Mod lets you possess and drive a real live vehicle already moving in Cities: Skylines II. This update keeps the tested Direct Drive system, the cleaner top-left COUI driving panel, safer crashguard paths around control/chase/camera cleanup, improved police chase retargeting for assigned units, the tested GTA-style attached chase camera, and unlocked manual tuning values.
Feedback / bug reports: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/beta-test-driving-mod-feedback-and-bug-reports.1925686/
Source transparency: https://github.com/northernst11-bot/BetaTestDrivingMod
The source is available for transparency and inspection only. It is not open source, and copying, rebuilding, reuploading, forking, or publishing derivative versions is not permitted without permission.
Police chase disclaimer: the chase feature is still in testing. It uses Cities: Skylines II police patrol/pathfinding systems, but dispatch may fail, arrive late, or behave weirdly depending on police coverage, nearby units, traffic, and the game's own patrol AI.
## Features
- Possess/release a real live vehicle with V - Arrow-key driving controls, recommended if WASD moves your camera or screen - WASD also works as a fallback - Top-left driving panel for speed, input status, possession, road assist toggles, and tuning sliders - Tuning fields apply typed numbers on Enter or when leaving the field - Manual tuning values are no longer capped by the old speed, steering, response, road attach, or camera ranges - UI-safe panel layout that avoids unsupported display styles in the Cities: Skylines II UI runtime - F8 also opens or closes the driving panel - F7 toggles the attached behind-car chase camera - Camera distance, height, and look-ahead tuning sliders in the panel - Optional police chase testing toggle, plus Start Chase/F9 while driving - Chase retarget refresh so assigned police units keep following the moving possessed car instead of the original chase point - Emergency/warning light effects are forced on assigned chase units while the chase is active - Crashguard safety around possession/control, path-freeze, chase camera restore, and experimental police chase dispatch - Lane-object cleanup on release so traffic is less likely to remember the possessed car at an old location - Frame-buffered keyboard input with latched quick taps - Direct physical vehicle movement after the game's normal car movement step - Vanilla physical path driving is frozen for the possessed car so AI movement does not fight player control - Road-height assist keeps the car attached to nearby road lanes with the tested no-hover behavior - Road intent assist queues AI left/right path intent from steering input without forcing the physical body to turn itself - Lane object presence sync so other traffic reacts to the possessed car's current lane position - Nearby road-lane search instead of expensive whole-city scanning - Brake-first reverse behavior: hold Down/S to stop, release and press again to reverse
## Notes
This is a beta test mod. It controls one possessed live road car and does not replace the whole traffic system. The older bus/train/watercraft experimental controls and expensive junction override are not active in this public direct-drive build.
